author: Ahmed Ibrahim
title: Denver Broncos Preseason Recap & 2025 Outlook
text:
Broncos Training Camp Insights: Joint Practice Takeaways & Cardinals Preseason Preview A deep dive into the Denver Broncos’ training camp, featuring analysis from team reporter Elisa Hernandez and lead writer Aric DiLalla, reveals key observations from joint practices, standout player performances, and a preview of the upcoming preseason matchup against the Arizona Cardinals. The discussion, featured on the “Altitude Advantage” podcast, offers fans a comprehensive look at the team’s preparation for the 2024 season.
Initial Impressions from Joint Practice The initial segment of the “Altitude Advantage” episode, spanning the first seven minutes and thirty-nine seconds, focused on takeaways from recent joint practice sessions. Analysts highlighted the value of these practices in simulating game-day intensity and providing valuable reps against different opponents. According to the discussion, these sessions allowed coaches to evaluate players in realistic scenarios, identifying areas for improvement and solidifying starting positions.
Emerging Stars & Training Camp Standouts From the seven-minute and forty-second mark to eleven minutes and nine seconds, Hernandez and DiLalla shifted their focus to players who have distinguished themselves during training camp . Several athletes were singled out for their performance, demonstrating significant growth and potential. The conversation underscored the importance of these early camp performances in shaping the team’s depth chart and identifying potential contributors throughout the season. A key theme was the emergence of unexpected talent, suggesting a competitive environment within the Broncos organization.
Scouting the Cardinals: Preseason Focus The final portion of the podcast, from eleven minutes and ten seconds to seventeen minutes and four seconds, centered on the upcoming preseason game against the Arizona Cardinals. The analysts outlined specific aspects of the Cardinals’ team that the Broncos will be closely evaluating, as well as key areas where the Broncos need to demonstrate improvement. This segment provided a strategic overview of the game, highlighting potential matchups and tactical considerations.
The discussion emphasized the importance of evaluating young players and refining the team’s offensive and defensive schemes during the preseason. A primary focus will be on assessing the performance of the offensive line and the development of the quarterback position.
